text_description: Runway look shown from head to upper thigh with a layered, skin-baring silhouette: an oversized black, grey, and white nubby tweed-like woven jacket/coat is worn open over a minimal black triangle bra top, exposing the chest and midriff. The outer layer has a wide turned-up collar framing the neck, broad relaxed shoulders, bracelet-length sleeves pushed or rolled up, and multiple shiny gold-tone buttons running down the front edges and placed on visible pocket/flap areas, giving the textured monochrome fabric a structured, utility-jacket feel despite the loose fit. Beneath it, the black bra top sits low with narrow straps and a small gold-tone logo-like ornament at the center front. The bottom is a matching tweed-like wrap skirt or skirt panel in the same salt-and-pepper texture, gathered/draped diagonally across the hips over a high black waistband or underlayer, with a visible gold-tone button near the waist and a high front-side slit exposing the upper thigh. Styling emphasizes contrast between the bulky open outerwear and minimal black underlayers, accented by long bright red drop earrings, a small delicate pendant necklace, loose wavy hair, and a sharp palette of monochrome texture, black, gold hardware, and red accessories.
